vital_corrections.citation_evidence: Statement of Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23, confirming his Ancestry tree profile for Stanley Oliver Davis Sr as accurate: 'Stanley Oliver Davis Sr, born February 5, 1941, Millsboro, Delaware.' The tree profile's birth carries U.S. Public Records Index and U.S. Find A Grave Index citations (sources screenshot filed 2026-11-23, ~/workspace/genealogy-records/stanley-davis/).

Statement of Jequan Davis, 2026-11-23, confirming his Ancestry tree profile for Stanley Oliver Davis Sr as accurate: 'Stanley Oliver Davis Sr, died June 22, 2021, Millsboro, Delaware.' The tree profile's death cites the U.S. Find A Grave Index and the U.S. Public Records Index (sources screenshot filed 2026-11-23, ~/workspace/genealogy-records/stanley-davis/). Corroborated by his sister Maryland Phoebe Davis's funeral program (Feb 2020), which names Stanley Davis of Millsboro as a surviving brother, so he was living in 2020 and the archive's former 1990 death year is impossible.
